18. Prosecution examined 18 P.Ws. out of 20 C.S. witnesses C.S. witness no 16 Dr. Ataur Rahman and C.S. witness No. 19 C/194 Amjad Hossain were not examined at the trial C.S. witness No. 19 constable Amjad Hossain accompanied P.W. 17 constable A. Malek when they both escorted' deadbody of deceased Moniruddin to the P.M. doctor P.W. 16 Dr. Sahabuddin who received the dead body from P.W. 17 C.A. Malek and C.S. witness No. 19 constable Amjad Hossain p.w. 17 stated above fact. Therefore non examination of C.S. witness No. 19 can not give rise to any adverse presumption C.S. witness no. 16 Dr. Ataur Rahman issued injury certificates after examining injured Afzal Kha P.W. 2 and Abdil Kha P.W. 7. Injury certificates of P.W. 2 and P.W.7 were not proved at the trial and mark Ext., due to non-examination of C.S. witness no. 16. That also cannot be facts when the charge under section 323 of the Penal Code was found proved in view of oral evidence of P.W. 1,2,6,9 and 12 even without the injury certificate on the point issued by C.S. witness no. 16 Dr. Ataur Rahman, we shall discuss more on the point later on. 

 20. Therefore non-examination of said Shafiuddin cannot give rise to any adverse presumption. Defence suggestion to the effect that the case was filed at the ill advice or instigation of said Shafiuddin has no basis at all. 

 47. We have discussed above the evidence of P.W.1-4, 6-12, 16 and 18 in different connection, we stated earlier that P.W. 16, 17 and 18 were formal official witnesses such as p.m. doctor, constable and I/O. P.W.5, 8, 10, 11, 13, 14 and 15 were public witnesses who were not eye witnesses. Out of them P.W.14 M.U.P. Alauddin was a seizure witness P.W.I0 and 15 stated about holding of salish after occurrence and as per salish Tk. 100/- was paid for treatment of the injured and informant side was asked not to file any case. Other public witnesses stated that they heard occurrence. After wards, P.W.14 stated that Mugar is also called bamboo, Khatia, Some of the eye witnesses stated that accused Miajan gave Mugor blow and some stated that he gave bamboo Khatia blow on the chest of victim. Above anomoly cannot give rise to any adverse presumption or total defect. It may be mentioned that some alamats including bamboo Mugor or Khatia were seized durinvestigation by P.W.18 1/0 but those alamats including the said Mugor or khatia were not produced at the trial to be marked Mat Exts due to defective conduct of the prosecution, we also referred to all Exts. such seizure-list P.M. report, F.I.R. Map and Index during earlier discussion In view of discussion as above the appeal should be disposed of in following manner.
